final: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total FROM results GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall_total FROM driver_totals), paired AS (SELECT d.driverId, d.total, d.total * 1.0 / o.overall_total AS ratio FROM driver_totals d CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE d.total IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), avg_row AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.total, p.ratio, a.avg_total FROM paired p CROSS JOIN avg_row a WHERE a.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND p.total > a.avg_total) SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_kept_driver_total, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, AVG(total - avg_total) AS avg_kept_minus_avg FROM kept
